**Finding: AUDIT — compliant (preferred).**

Section 22 is the document's only audit right binding us; targeted searches for audit, records, inspection, monitoring and remote-access/self-certification language turned up nothing else (§ 23 carries only a heading). Section 22.1–22.2 satisfies every preferred element — once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express prohibition on direct access to our systems. Section 22.3 adds protections in our favour. No redline proposed.
